tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mahā kā la'i rjes gnang bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas chos sgrub pa'i cha rkyen du rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba zhu bar 'dod pa shin tu legs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang chos bsgrub pa la phyi nang gi bar chad 'byung bas/ de sel ba la chos skyong bsten dgos shing / de la 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa gnyis las/ 'jig rten pas tshe 'di'i bar chad tsam sel bar nus kyang / mchog gi dngos grub rtsol mi nus pas bsten yang dgos pa chung la/ 'jig rten las 'das pas 'di dang phyi ma'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun sel zhing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis ka rtsol bas brten na phan yon che bas 'dir rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i thugs kyi sprul pa gur gyi mgon por grags pa 'di'i rjes su gnang ba bgyid pa la/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang rjes su gnang ba gnyis las/ dang po'i dbang du byas na/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon cha 'di rdo rje gdan gyi ka bar sbas te gzhag dus phyis pad ma badzro zhes u rgyan du 'khrungs pa des bod du 'byon pa'i dus rdo rje gdan nas bton nas bsnams nas byon/ bka' mi nub par bya ba'i phyir rgya gar shar phyogs su dharm+ma pā la la rjes su bstan nas khong gangs ti se dang / mtsho ma dros pa gzigs su byon pa'i dus su lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang mjal nas rig pa'i gnas du ma dang chos skyong 'di'i skor rnams gnang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos khong rang gi nye gnas gu rub rin chen bsod nams zhes bya ba de la 'od zer can gyi pra brtag pa dang / nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs/ rkang mgyogs/ skye ba brtag pa/ gdams pa 'di'i skor la sogs pa mang du gnang / phyis lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis gcen gyi don du bod yul mtha' dag tu byon pa'i tshe bod yul tsam gyis 'gyur mi mthun pa'i 'gyur yang byas/

bstan pa bsrung ba'i mtshon cha 'di bsnams te byon nas/ lo tsā ba chen po la phul ba dang / chos skyong dang bstan srung gi gdams pa thams cad mthun par gzigs nas pho brang btsun pa nyid la gzhan la mi spel bar gtad par gda'/ yang lugs gcig la bhe dan gyi yul du bram ze mchog sred bde mchog la sogs pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su/ re ma ti lag mthil du bzhag nas sgong rtses dre rta la bskyon nas gling bzhi lan cig bskor/ rna ba gnyis nas bzung nas lan cig bskor/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bar chad byas nas myos par byas pas mgon pos de'i 'gram pa la thal lcag gis bsnun te/ 'di lta bu bstan pa la gnod pa byed dam/ dam sha za'am zer nas re ma ti myos su bcug nga'i sring mo 'dis khyed la da dung bar chad byed zer nas mgon po'i sgrub thabs gsum gnang / des nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ des shraddhā ka ra warma la/ des jo bo rin chen bzang po la/ des khong rang gi nye gnas brag stengs pa gu rub rin chen bsod nams la/ des mal lo tsā ba la gnang / de la bla chen kun dga' snying pos zhus te/ bla ma mal chos skyong 'di la bka' shin tu dog kyang / sa skya pa chen pos spyir yang bsnyen bkur mang du mdzad cing yun ring du bsten/ khyad par du gser srang bcu bdun phul bas mnyes nas sku 'da' kar gdugs la sogs pa yang gnang nas gtad/ chos skyong 'di'i rjes gnang mdzad nas/ rten du gu rum du chos skyong gi sku dang / dar nag kha gang / lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa gcig dang / gdams ngag skor ma lus pa bka' rgya dang bcas nas gnang ngo / /de nas sa skya pa chen po gdan sar byon pa'i dus su ban chung rnams kyis chos skyong gi sku 'cham gyin grang po khra bo la'i phar phyogs nas 'ong ba dang / tshur phyogs nas 'gron po gcig 'ongs pa gnyis la rtser phrad pas khrag skyugs nas shi/ de phyin chad chos skyong gnyen po'i grags pa yang thob/

de nas gu rum du gdan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol/ de phyin chad chos skyong dang dngos su gsung gleng mdzad ces grag go /de la rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos/ de la rje btsun chen po/ de la chos rje pa/ de la 'phags pa/ de la dam pa kun dga' grags/ de la bdag chen pas gsan/ de la bdag gis thos/ yang 'phags pa 'phags rgyal/ de la bla ma rin chen bzang pos zhus/ des bdag yang na 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ de la bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bdag gis zhus so/ /gnyis pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po la/ gsol ba gdab cing skyabs su 'gro ba/ sdom pa gzung ba/ byin rlabs kyi gzhi bca' ba dang gsum las dang po ni/ maṇḍal byed du bcug la/ gang gi drin gyis dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /la sogs pa rjes zlos byed du bcug ste/ bla ma dang yi dam la skyabs su 'gro ba'o/ /de nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che'i sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs la/ bdag la dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum bzlas su bcug gnyis pa ni/ byang sems dang rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa dang mi ldan na gsang sngags kyi lam sgrub tu mi rung zhing / bka' srung khyad par can 'di lta bu bsgrub pa'ang dam tshig gtsang ba gal che bas/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa mtha' dag gzung snyam pa mdzod byas la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi la sogs dang / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /zhes sogs lan gsum zlos su gzhug gsum pa ni/ slob dpon la rdo rje 'chang du mos pa bgyis byas la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi thugs kar phog thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi lus la phog gdon bgegs sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gyi sha lus tshogs pa'i lus bsregs nas/

stong par gyur par sgom mo/ /dngos gzhi la gsum gyi sku'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi dbus su mngon rtogs bzhin/ mgon po'i skur slob ma gyur cing / g.yon du e ka dza ṭī dang lha mo'ang bsgom du gzhug de nas bla ma la gus 'dud byas pas bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mgon po lcam dral gyi sku dpag tu med pa spyan drangs rang rang gi lus la thim/ gdon bgegs tshar bcad/ sdig sgrib dag sku'i rjes gnang thob par bsgom du gzhug gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ sngar ltar 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mtha' ma na/ snying po dang rtsa sngags/ lha mo'i thugs kar bhyo'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las mar me gcig las gnyis chad bzhin du zhal nas 'thon/ slob ma'i snying kar hūm̐ gi tha ma dang / g.yon gyi lha mo'i thugs kar bhyo'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs la/ shā sa na dang / sngags thung dang / ro ru lan gsum gyi rjes su bcom ldan bdag la zhes sogs lan gsum zlos su gzhug de nas/ bla mas bcom ldan 'di la zhes sogs lan gsum brjod pas gsung gi rjes gnang thob par bsgom du gzhug gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ sngar bzhin gyi 'od 'phro 'du las/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas ye shes lnga'i ngo bo gri gug thod pa/ gaṇḍī/ ral gri/ mdung / rtse gsum la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs/ slob ma'i snying kar thim/ mgon po lcam dral gyi thugs dang / slob ma'i sems dbyer med du gyur par bsgom du gzhug rjes gnang gsum char gyi mthar gu gul gyi bdug rol mo'i sgra bsgrags so/ /thugs kyi rjes gnang thob par mos pa gyis/

gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gsum ste/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ slob ma'i spyi bor chos skyong gi gtor ma gzhag gtor ma chos skyong du dpon slob gnyis kas bsams la/ slob dpon gyis sngags gsum po tshar re brjod pa'i rjes la/ 'di'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan gyi mthar/ bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs la/ slob ma che ge mo zhes bya ba'i lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub pa dang / bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba ba dang / 'go ba dang / mnyes pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzod cig ces brjod cing chos skyong spyi bor thim par bsgom du gzhug go /gnyis pa dam bca' ba ni/ 'di lta bu'i chos skyong bsten phyin chad/ mchod pas mnyes par byed dgos pas/ rab zhag gcig la thun gsum/ 'bring thun re/ tha ma tshes brgyad/ bco lnga/ dgu/ tha ma'i tha mas kyang nyer dgu la gtor ma ma chags par gtong ba'i yi dam gyis byas la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /'di dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum zlos su gzhug gsum pa yon dbul ba ni/ maṇḍal dang / yon ci 'byor ba phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te/ zhes sogs lan gsum zlos su gzhug go /dpal mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang gi brjed byang / btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba// //shubhaṃ// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 bla ma dam pa/ mahākāla'i rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
